name: patchproof
description: Review, fix and explain code changes with concrete verification evidence and plain-language limits.

interface.longDescription: Explain AI-generated changes, investigate concrete regressions, make focused fixes and prepare factual handoffs. Includes a read-only Git inventory helper. Reviews remain agent-assisted; the plugin does not certify correctness or security.
defaultPrompt: Check my changes and explain them in plain English.
Fix this bug and show what proves the fix works.
Prepare a handoff with what was tested and what is still uncertain.
